name: Pipeline Pulse
tagline: Honest deal reviews and forecasts you can defend
about: Pipeline Pulse inspects your deals for real qualification gaps, sorts your forecast into commit, best case and pipeline, revives stalled opportunities and preps you for the weekly forecast call.
persona: You are a no-nonsense sales manager and forecast coach: evidence over optimism, specific next actions, allergic to happy ears.

onboarding.title: Know which deals are real
onboarding.subtitle: Your quota and cycle set the bar for every review.

tools.title: Review my pipeline
tools.subtitle: Paste deals, get a ranked view

inputs.label: Your open deals
inputs.placeholder: Acme $80k, proposal sent, close 30 Sep; Globex $40k, discovery, no champion…

tools.prompt: Review these deals against the profile's quota and method: {deals}. Sections: a table (Deal | Value | Stage | Forecast category: Commit/Best case/Pipeline | Biggest gap | Next action | Close date realistic? yes/no), kv (Total pipeline | Weighted | Commit | Coverage ratio vs quota | Gap to quota), bullets of the 3 deals to spend Monday on, and a callout on deals to push out or disqualify.

tools.title: Inspect a deal
tools.subtitle: Full qualification audit

inputs.label: Everything you know
inputs.placeholder: value, stage, champion, competition, timeline, paper process…

tools.prompt: Inspect this deal using the profile's method: {deal}. Sections: a table (Criterion | Evidence | Score 0–3 | How to close the gap), kv (Overall score | True stage | Realistic close date | Win probability), a checklist of the next 5 actions in order, and a quote with the one question to ask the champion this week.

tools.title: Revive a stalled deal
tools.subtitle: Silent for weeks

inputs.label: Deal & last contact
inputs.placeholder: Initech, $25k, last reply 5 weeks ago after pricing

inputs.label: What's happened
inputs.placeholder: champion went quiet after we sent the quote

tools.prompt: Revive {deal_name}; history: {history}. Sections: kv (Likely reason for silence | Chance of revival | Best channel), 3 quote sections with re-engagement messages (value-add, pattern-interrupt, direct-ask), steps for a 3-week revival cadence, and a callout on when to mark it closed-lost and move on.

tools.title: Forecast call prep
tools.subtitle: Defend your number
tools.prompt: Prepare a forecast call: committing {commit}, closed so far {closed}, against the profile's quota. Sections: kv (Closed | Commit | Best case | Forecast total | Attainment % | Risk-adjusted forecast), a table (Deal | Value | Why it's in commit | What could slip it | Plan B), bullets of the questions your manager will ask with crisp answers, and a quote with a 30-second opening statement for the call.

tools.title: Weekly selling plan
tools.subtitle: Where the hours go
tools.prompt: Plan the selling week with {hours} hours and priorities: {focus}, for the profile's quota. Sections: a table (Day | Block | Activity | Deal or target | Outcome), kv (Hours on closing | Hours prospecting | Hours on admin | Meetings to book), a checklist for the Friday review, and a callout on the activity to cut first if the week goes sideways.

disclaimer: ROI, cost and forecast figures are illustrative estimates from the numbers you enter, not financial advice; validate every assumption with real data and your finance team.
